parameters.name: Collection
parameters.description:
The name of the document collection.

> The document collection is created by calling the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation. You can call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to query existing document collections.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description:
The file name.

> The name of a previously uploaded file. You can call the [ListDocuments](~~2618453~~) operation to query the file list.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description:
The filter condition for the data to query, in SQL WHERE clause format. The filter is an expression that returns a Boolean value (true or false). Conditions can be simple comparison operators such as equal to (=), not equal to (<> or !=), greater than (>), less than (<), greater than or equal to (>=), and less than or equal to (<=). You can also use logical operators (AND, OR, NOT) to combine more complex expressions, as well as conditions with the IN, BETWEEN, and LIKE keywords.

> 
> - For detailed syntax, refer to: https://www.postgresqltutorial.com/postgresql-tutorial/postgresql-where/

parameters.name: IncludeVector
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return vectors. Default value: false.
> - **false**: Does not return vectors.
> - **true**: Returns vectors.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace. Default value: public.

> You can create a namespace by calling the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation and query the list of namespaces by calling the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation.

parameters.name: NamespacePassword
parameters.description:
The password of the namespace.
> This value is specified by the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of records per page. Valid values:

- **20**
- **50**
- **100**

Default value: **20**.
